queryParams.description: ISIN (International Securities Identification Number) to retrieve brand data for (e.g., 'AU000000IMD5', 'US0378331005'). Must be exactly 12 characters: 2 letters followed by 9 alphanumeric characters and ending with a digit.

queryParams.name: force_language
queryParams.description: Optional parameter to force the language of the retrieved brand data.

queryParams.name: maxSpeed
queryParams.description: Optional parameter to optimize the API call for maximum speed. When set to true, the API will skip time-consuming operations for faster response at the cost of less comprehensive data.

queryParams.name: timeoutMS
queryParams.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the request. If the request takes longer than this value, it will be aborted with a 408 status code. Maximum allowed value is 300000ms (5 minutes).

endpoints.name: Take screenshot of website
endpoints.description: Capture a screenshot of a website. Supports both viewport (standard browser view) and full-page screenshots. Can also screenshot specific page types (login, pricing, etc.) by using heuristics to find the appropriate URL. Returns a URL to the uploaded screenshot image hosted on our CDN.

queryParams.name: domain
queryParams.description: Domain name to take screenshot of (e.g., 'example.com', 'google.com'). The domain will be automatically normalized and validated.

queryParams.name: fullScreenshot
queryParams.description: Optional parameter to determine screenshot type. If 'true', takes a full page screenshot capturing all content. If 'false' or not provided, takes a viewport screenshot (standard browser view).

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: Optional parameter to specify which page type to screenshot. If provided, the system will scrape the domain's links and use heuristics to find the most appropriate URL for the specified page type (30 supported languages). If not provided, screenshots the main domain landing page.

queryParams.name: prioritize
queryParams.description: Optional parameter to prioritize screenshot capture. If 'speed', optimizes for faster capture with basic quality. If 'quality', optimizes for higher quality with longer wait times. Defaults to 'quality' if not provided.

endpoints.name: Extract products from a brand's website

bodyParams.name: maxProducts

bodyParams.name: timeoutMS
bodyParams.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the request. If the request takes longer than this value, it will be aborted with a 408 status code. Maximum allowed value is 300000ms (5 minutes).

endpoints.name: Retrieve brand data by email address
endpoints.description: Retrieve brand information using an email address while detecting disposable and free email addresses. This endpoint extracts the domain from the email address and returns brand data for that domain. Disposable and free email addresses (like gmail.com, yahoo.com) will throw a 422 error.

queryParams.name: email
queryParams.description: Email address to retrieve brand data for (e.g., 'contact@example.com'). The domain will be extracted from the email. Free email providers (gmail.com, yahoo.com, etc.) and disposable email addresses are not allowed.

queryParams.name: force_language
queryParams.description: Optional parameter to force the language of the retrieved brand data.

queryParams.name: maxSpeed
queryParams.description: Optional parameter to optimize the API call for maximum speed. When set to true, the API will skip time-consuming operations for faster response at the cost of less comprehensive data.

queryParams.name: timeoutMS
queryParams.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the request. If the request takes longer than this value, it will be aborted with a 408 status code. Maximum allowed value is 300000ms (5 minutes).
